headline: GOLD leaders say COPD's old narrative is outdated in 2027 update
dek: The American Journal of Managed Care reports that leaders of GOLD describe the traditional narrative around COPD as outdated, in connection with a 2027 update.
body:
GOLD leaders say the old narrative around chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is outdated, according to a news item published by The American Journal of Managed Care.

The item links the statement to a 2027 update. The text available for this article consists only of the headline and publisher name, and it does not identify the individual GOLD leaders, describe what the old narrative was, or set out what the update contains.

Further detail was not available in the source material.
key_quote: COPD’s Old Narrative Is Outdated, GOLD Leaders Say in 2027 Update

source.title: COPD’s Old Narrative Is Outdated, GOLD Leaders Say in 2027 Update - The American Journal of Managed Care
source.author_name: The American Journal of Managed Care

headline: Vaccine Guidance Review Panel endorses influenza, RSV and COVID-19 recommendations
dek: The American Thoracic Society said on X that the multi-medical society panel endorsed recommendations on influenza, RSV and COVID-19 vaccines for adults and children.
body:
The Vaccine Guidance Review Panel has announced its endorsement of influenza, RSV and COVID-19 recommendations for adults and children, according to a post from the American Thoracic Society (ATS).

The ATS described the panel as "a multi-medical society effort". In the post, published on X on 5 November 2026, the society directed readers to a linked page to learn more.

The post did not set out the content of the recommendations, name the participating societies or explain how the panel reached its decision. Readers seeking those details are referred to the material linked from the post.

The ATS's profile on X describes it as a leading medical association dedicated to advancing pulmonary, critical care and sleep medicine globally, with more than 22,000 members.
key_quote: announced its endorsement of influenza, RSV and COVID-19 recommendations for adults and children

issues: The article says the ATS's "profile on X" describes it as a leading medical association with more than 22,000 members. The source only supplies this as author_bio metadata and does not say it comes from the X profile, so the attribution to the profile is unsupported.
